name: Pyro Volcanique
description: Phénix tacticien utilisant ses cendres pour bloquer les lignes ennemies et créer des murs de fumée infranchissables.

subject.archetype: Pyro Volcanique — Héritiers des cendres Rare class spore

loadout.armor_outfit: Armor forged from melted debris and volcanic slag, dark metal plates held by thermal bonds glowing orange at every seam, heat distortion rising from every surface, scorch marks and soot coating every inch with distinctive faction engravings and glowing energy channel conduits running along seams
loadout.arsenal: Dual flame projector gauntlets superheated to molten temperatures dripping liquid fire, volcanic glass blade still glowing cherry red at core, ash grenades on belt radiating heat The weapon and gauntlets actively channel the character's heal ability targeting self, visible energy conduits linking weapon to body with flowing power

attitude.behavior: Combat specialist engaged in the heat of battle with weapon and body fully committed to the fight. Hands pressed urgently against wounds as focused targeted golden regenerative energy wraps around injuries in cocoon of restorative light, visible flesh and armor mending in real time
attitude.emotion: Lethal intensity — predator recognizing the perfect strike moment

style.rendering_style: cinematic action photography with gritty realism, motion blur on projectiles and debris, sharp focus on character face and primary weapon, high contrast lighting with dramatic deep shadows

palette_names.name: Ember Orange
palette_names.role: primary_accent — flames, energy blasts and burning particles

palette_names.name: Magma Yellow
palette_names.role: tertiary accent — lava flows and inner core glow

color_and_light.lighting_setup: cobalt steel frame with etched faction symbols running along each border edge, explosive backlight from ability discharge, dramatic rim lighting separating character from environmental chaos, volumetric light rays cutting through smoke and particles

camera.angle: Low dramatic angle emphasizing dominance, wide enough to show full environmental impact of the ability

scenography.setting: Volcanic battlefield mid-eruption with lava rivers bursting through cracked ground flowing around combat zone, character standing in center of massive firestorm, burning debris raining from ash-choked sky, enemy positions engulfed in flames with structures collapsing into molten ground
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Golden light flowing from within outward through every wound and crack, flesh healing before eyes, armor plates reforming, blood reversing flow as body rapidly repairs itself, Light radiating from character illuminating nearby area in warm golden tones, ground beneath blooming with new growth from overflow of restorative energy, Massive fireball erupting from character engulfing foreground with intense orange light, lava cracking through ground with molten splashes flying up in slow motion, embers and ash swirling in thermal vortex, visible heat distortion waves rippling the air, secondary explosions in background sending shockwaves through smoke
